items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: You had Hank Jones, he was the pianist... in that hand of Charlie Turner's

ctx.x: Excuse me, the Hank Jones that was playing piano --

Not the same one. This is the Hank Jones -- was a little fellow, little, small fellow. He come from Louisville, Kentucky. Small fellow. Someone said "Hank Jones is here." I made that mistake when I come back, but I knew there was another Hank Jones.

So I went with that band and I stayed there. And I got a telegram from Paris to come to join Willy Lewis's band. And I was happy with Willy Bryant's band. Very happy.
